column3: No choice but to fight! Don't stop me!
A nightmare of countless nights... just one step away...
Unable, I gasp in the mire, trying to shake off my clinging past...
Now... will our little mouse survive...?
Someone is making me remember the past I tried to forget...
Fyana, can you ride an AT?
I keep fighting in this hell... cursing myself...
First, I need to grab an AT...
If you want to die so badly... so be it...
I'll destroy anything in my way...
Damn! Used up, then shipped to the front...
So you came, Red Shoulder... heh heh...
For my last remaining pride as a warrior...
A hit to the cockpit means injury. Or death!
Red Shoulder red is darker... blood red.
The mark goes on the right.
On landing, hide and stand by!
I've finally found the Fyana I sought, yet...
Why track down Borough and his group...?
Puppets of fate... Who guides us...?
Either way, I'll have my answer soon...
Like fish for a cat, an AT for Chirico!
Too right. Chirico in an AT's worth 100.
Destined to become more than human...
As the chosen heir to rule Astragius...
After the Hundred Years' War truce, Chirico hid in Uoodo, hunted by the Melkian army for reasons unknown. What fate awaits him?
Chirico joins Battling... only to face a deadly "Real Battle." Can he come out on top?
Talks with Iskui have broken down, and his men have them surrounded. Can Chirico's crew escape this crisis?
Uoodo is flooded with Security Police. Can Chirico survive the all-out assault?
Chirico meets the Specimen again at the police base, but it's packed with hired Battling fighters. Can he escape with her?
No time to savor the reunion with Vanilla: Chirico must fight off a raid. Can he repel the enemy with his fellow mercs?
Despite the covert op, Kan Yu ignored Chirico's warning and started a needless fight. Can they protect the disguised boat and carry on?
Chirico's group reaches Kanjelman Palace. To unmask the mysterious group, Chirico goes after its agent, Borough.
Ship X crash-lands on Sunsa, where Ypsilon's Secret Society AT squad attacks. Can Chirico drive off the PS Ypsilon?
Zophie, who hates Chirico, attacks, but at Fyana's request he avoids the fight. Refill oxygen from containers and find the entrance to the old army site with the Jijirium.
As Fyana and Rochina watch, Chirico and Ypsilon's final duel begins. Who will survive?
Chirico crosses the desert to meet Wiseman, but the allied Gilgamesh-Balarant army lies in wait. Can he reach Wiseman alive?
Chirico finally stands before Wiseman, but one last AT blocks his way. Will he achieve his goal?
Beating Lt. Konin made Chirico famous, and tough fighters line up to challenge him. Defeat the challengers!
Rescued by Gotho, Chirico is challenged to a Real Battle. Battered as you are, beat the unknown foe!
Chirico plans to infiltrate the Security Police and must first confuse them. Destroy their supply containers in Uoodo as a diversion.
Chirico was gathering intel in town, but the Security Police caught on. Get back to Gotho's hideout fast!
You've stolen the police's Jijirium trailer. Guard it, with Coconna aboard, until it reaches Gotho's hideout.
To dig up police intel, Chirico leaves his AT and scouts the police base on foot. Avoid fighting and reach the base.
Just after you infiltrate the police, the Brutishdog returns. You can't lose twice. Get revenge!
Chirico climbs the police base to unmask the group. Ignore other foes and reach the top.
Uoodo burns. Melkian AT forces raining down on the city attack without mercy. Repel them and escape Uoodo!
Caught unready by a Vilar raid, Chirico fights back. You can't win like this. Steal an enemy AT and wipe them out!
Vilar choppers attack mid-mission. Drive them off quickly!
Escort a boat of spare ATs from the Munamera River to Calde Swamp. Protect it until it leaves the area.
On a mission under Gon Nu's orders, Chirico's team is attacked by Ypsilon's guerrilla ATs. Eliminate them fast!
Fyana escaped a downed chopper and is hunted by Vilar guerrillas on Borough's orders. Ypsilon tries to protect her. Rescue Fyana!
Reunited with Fyana, Chirico is now hunted by the Vilar and his former allies alike. Crossing the river toward the palace, wipe out the waiting Vilar!
The Vilar strike again as Chirico heads for the palace. Wipe out the guerrillas!
To prevent a long siege, Chirico targets the palace supplies. Destroy every supply container!
Chirico's team reaches the palace. Clear the AT squad in your way and get inside fast!
Late in the Hundred Years' War, Chirico joins an operation on the Taipas River. Can he survive?
The Kummen journey ends as Melkian ATs attack guerrillas and mercs alike. Repel the Melkian AT forces!
Keep the supplies from the Secret Society. Destroy every container on the ship!
The Balarant attack Ship X with Chirico aboard. Fight off their AT squad alongside Fyana!
Fyana is in seizure from lack of Jijirium, so Chirico heads for the old supply base, but the Balarant attack. Shield Fyana and destroy their AT squad!
A Balarant AT squad attacks, but without Jijirium Fyana can't fight for long. Shield her and destroy the enemy fast!
The Balarant attack and you have no AT. You can't win like this. Steal one and wipe them out!
A Secret Society AT squad attacks. Destroy them fast!
The Society attacks and you have no AT. You can't win like this. Steal one and wipe them out!
A huge allied AT force blocks Chirico's path. Destroy every enemy AT!
To halt the army, destroy the supply containers in the Quent Desert.
Enemy ATs close in before Wiseman. Wipe them out!
Moved to the Red Shoulder, Chirico is targeted by Grego's crew. Fearing his uncanny survival, Pailsen throws them into the battle of Sunsa.
After fleeing Uoodo, Chirico reunites with Grego and his old comrades and joins their plot to bring down Pailsen. What awaits them...?
After defeating Wiseman, Chirico wandered with Fyana in search of Jijirium. Then Fyana was kidnapped, and to get her back he must fight in a high-stakes Big Battle.
32 years after entering cold sleep, Chirico is revived. To save Fyana, taken while half-revived, he must face Teitania, a next-gen PS called a Nextant.
The Brutishdog Fyana was piloting has been destroyed. Escape the base while holding Fyana in the Scopedog's right arm!
Gilgamesh's main AT, built in countless numbers until the war's truce. Highly versatile, with many variants.
A Scopedog modified for swamp combat. Its air barges and hydro jets let it fight on water.
A Scopedog customized for Battling. Its stereo scope gives the pilot a realistic view. Note: "Purple Bear" is a ring name, not an official one.
A Scopedog customized for Battling, notable for heavy armor and high defense. Note: "Strong Backs" is a ring name, not an official one.
A Scopedog with swapped polymer ringer fluid and control computer for better space combat. Many were carried on Ship X.
A custom model with jet roller dash built into the legs, boosting top speed by about 20%. Armament varies by pilot preference.
A Scopedog stripped of armor to the limit to maximize mobility. Gliding wheels are added to the legs.
A Scopedog customized so the Quentian Shakko can pilot it.||Fitted with heavy-class AT parts and a pile bunker to resemble the Berserga line.
A heavy AT for swamp and underwater use. Airtight; it lasts 2 hours submerged.
Gilgamesh's standard heavy AT, also used by the Secret Society. Strong and versatile; many upgrades are based on it.
A redesigned Standing Tortoise with rocket boosters on the back and legs for space combat. Its frame is also reinforced.
An old Berserga customized for desert use with sand trippers on its legs.
A heavy AT made on Quent for Quentians only. It has precise metal-detecting radar using Quent elements and a pile bunker in its shield.
The Balarant's standard AT, specialized for space combat. Unlike the Scopedog, its legs use hover propulsion. "Fatty" is a Gilgamesh nickname; its official name is "ATB-01 Frogger."
A Fatty customized for ground use, with sand loaders on its legs for better desert mobility.
A light AT developed by the Secret Society. Special plastic armor makes it far lighter. Its high mobility means only skilled pilots can handle it.
A heavy AT developed as the Scopedog's successor, modified by the Secret Society. Flown by former Red Shoulder members.
A custom machine based on the Scopedog. It mounts trample riggers for rough terrain and a Droppers Folding Gun that can destroy an AT in one shot.

Age 18. The hero. Raised amid war since childhood, he is quiet and poor with people. But his combat skill is high, and his AT piloting is superhuman. As a Melkian AT pilot, he once served in the Red Shoulder (Melkian Strategic Armored Cavalry Special Mission Unit X-1).

A black marketeer in Uoodo and former Melkian air force pilot. Cheerful, always joking and smiling.||At first he wanted to use Chirico to make money, but after surviving deadly battles together he became a true friend.

A war orphan in Uoodo and one of Chirico's friends. Bright and tomboyish, she gets by day to day doing odd jobs for Gotho and Vanilla.||She has a crush on Chirico, and often talks Gotho and the others out of abandoning him when he's in trouble.

A Uoodo black marketeer and Battling matchmaker who saved Chirico when he was hunted in Uoodo. He saw Chirico's talent as a pilot and schemed to profit from it, but he's a lovable old man.||He comes to understand Chirico, and with Vanilla and Coconna, becomes one of his closest friends.

A mysterious woman with many names: the Specimen, Perfect Soldier, Proto One, Phantom Lady.||In truth she is a combat android made by the Melkian army, a "Specimen" with muscles and reflexes boosted by gene engineering.

Ex-Gilgamesh major and Secret Society leader, part of the unit after the Specimen on Lido.||As Uoodo's police chief, he manages the Specimen with Borough. Learning Chirico survived Lido, he seeks his life.
Serge Borough|CAST: Kenichi Ogata~~Serge Borough|CAST: K. Ogata
Ex-Gilgamesh major and Secret Society leader, part of the unit after the Specimen on Lido.||He manages the Specimen in Uoodo with Iskui. A psychology expert, he handles the Society's PS development.
Ex-Gilgamesh major general and the Society's top leader, driving the PS project.
Bomo:|A Uoodo Battling fighter. Irked by newcomer Chirico, he was to face him in his debut, set up by Gotho to settle things. His skills are said to be mediocre.
Kummen's third prince, who pushed modernization, then suddenly united its foes and led the Holy Kingdom of Kummen in revolt against his own land.

The second Perfect Soldier made by the Secret Society. Deeply in love with Fyana, he hates Chirico just as deeply and hunts him relentlessly.||Proud of being a Perfect Soldier, he believes he is a special warrior.
A Quentian mercenary over 2 meters tall. Quiet and reserved, but one of Assemble EX-10's top AT pilots.||Assigned with Chirico to Kan Yu's unit.
Commander of Assemble EX-10, a major general tied to Melkian intelligence.||His right eye is artificial.
Captain and AT leader of Assemble EX-10. A petty commander his men don't trust, he hates Chirico and hinders him at every turn.
An Assemble EX-10 merc. Hot-tempered and greedy, but one of EX-10's top AT pilots.||Assigned with Chirico to Kan Yu's unit.
An Assemble EX-10 merc, formerly of the Kummen royal guard. A local, he became a merc to modernize Kummen.||Assigned with Chirico to Kan Yu's unit.
Aron Schmittel|CAST: Akio Nojima|Gran Schmittel|CAST: K. Futamata

Leader of Sunsa's salvage arms dealers and an old friend of Gotho. The Red Shoulder killed her family.||She sheltered Chirico's group after Ship X, but learning he was ex-Red Shoulder, she hunted him for revenge.
The Balarant's first PS, a Battling fighter in A-Coba. Maimed by the Red Shoulder, he volunteered to become a PS for revenge.

Founder of the Red Shoulder. Seeking a unit of "ultimate soldiers," he studied Chirico's undying genetic traits as an Abnormal Survivor.||After the unit disbanded he quit the army, joined the Secret Society, and ran the PS program.

A Red Shoulder master sergeant. Ordered by Riemann to kill Chirico, he joined him after nearly being killed too.||Right before the war ended, Pailsen sent him to the front, where he got a big scar on his face.
After the unit disbanded, he set out to gather Chirico and other ex-Red Shoulders for revenge on Pailsen.
A Red Shoulder corporal, a delinquent who ran with Grego. Sent to the front by Pailsen at war's end, he lost his right arm.||After the unit disbanded, he answered Grego's call.
A Red Shoulder corporal, a delinquent who ran with Grego; he clashes with Baiman.||Sent to the front at war's end, he told of the mission, and his whole family was killed for it.

Commander of the Red Shoulder base. He helped Pailsen create a unit of "ultimate soldiers."||Unhappy with how Chirico was handled, he doubted Pailsen's Abnormal Survivor theory, and so ordered Grego's crew to kill Chirico.
